title: Menu Analysis
description: Cost %, profit per serving and menu engineering for what was sold. Protect Stars, fix Plowhorses, promote Puzzles, review Dogs.

classHint.STAR: Popular and profitable: keep quality and placement.
classHint.PLOWHORSE: Popular, low profit: review portion, recipe cost or price.
classHint.PUZZLE: Profitable, sells little: promote, rename or reposition.
classHint.DOG: Low popularity and profit: rework or remove.

table.estimated: Part of the cost estimated from today's recipe / purchase cost

rules: Popular = sells at least 70% of a fair share (1 / items sold). High profit = profit per serving at or above the menu average.
